shared_elements: bird-like head in profile with prominent beak
horizontal band of repeated motifs running along the top edge
low/raised relief carving on a stone slab surface
row of small repeated rounded/loop forms
animal figures shown in profile against a plain ground
justification: Both slabs place a horizontal register of small repeated motifs across the upper edge above a field containing beaked, profile creatures, which is a genuine and reasonably specific compositional echo. However, A is a single dominant, high-relief, densely ornamented head with spirals, discs and modelled feathering carved in polished stone, while B is a shallow, sparse, schematic scattering of small flat figures on a rough pillar — the manner of carving and the density of the field could hardly be more different.
